title: ShopCapabilityModel
description: MP-S1 (ADR-0022) data contract: an engineer's DECLARATION of one shop's manufacturing capability. schema_version 1.0.0. MP-owned input. Every ProcessOp must be either mapped in op_capability or listed in unsupported_ops; every mapped capability must be provided by a resource or listed in unsupported_capabilities; every resource capability must be mapped (declared intent, checked by the loader). supported_materials is SHOP-WIDE: it is not machine-specific (documented MP-S1 limitation). Identity: shop_content_hash covers only the semantic capability fields; shop_declaration_hash adds evidence_class and declaration. model_version (the contracted capability_model_version label), display_name and notes are in neither hash. evidence_class records WHO asserted the declaration and on what basis. It is NEVER independent verification; Mini Prometheus cannot check a declaration against a physical shop. Bump model_version only for a real revision; use display_name for naming.

EvidenceClass.title: EvidenceClass
EvidenceClass.description: synthetic: invented to exercise software, describes no real shop. public_specification: derived from published machine/material data, describes no specific shop (declaration.sources required). shop_declared: asserted by a person on behalf of a real shop, UNVERIFIED by Mini Prometheus or any independent party.
